nodes.label: Apple Health Data Analyzer
nodes.rationale: Desktop analytics app for Windows and Linux that imports Apple Health exports into MariaDB and presents insight-oriented dashboards with sleep as the signature experience.

nodes.label: MariaDB
nodes.rationale: Hard runtime dependency replacing local SQLite; networked storage enables shared data across devices but removes offline use.

nodes.label: DatabaseManager
nodes.rationale: Single SQL boundary wrapping PyMySQL with DictCursor, autocommit=false, string-typed temporal reads via conv override, and _to_mariadb_datetime on writes.

nodes.label: SleepAnalysisService
nodes.rationale: Groups sleep records into nights anchored at start_at minus 12h; consistency_score is a first-pass weighted-penalty heuristic not trend-based.

nodes.label: PyMySQL
nodes.rationale: Pure-Python MariaDB wire-protocol driver chosen over native mariadb connector to stay PyInstaller-friendly without bundling Connector/C.

nodes.label: Read-Only Imports Boundary
nodes.rationale: Imports/Data Manager is observability only: no delete, retry, export, credential editing, fingerprint display, or database maintenance; global Import button remains the sole write action.

nodes.label: Overview Option 1c Dense Mission Control
nodes.rationale: Fills empty Overview space with KPI row, 3-up mini-chart mosaic, sleep consistency gauge, and recent-imports table for at-a-glance scanning.

nodes.label: Overview Option 1a By The Book
nodes.rationale: Completes spec with 5 KPI cards plus embedded recent-trend visuals and record counts; closest to existing layout.

nodes.label: Overview Option 1b Insight Forward
nodes.rationale: Recovery ring hero plus auto-generated highlight callouts with status colors; editorial layout turning numbers into meaning.

nodes.label: Transparent QLabel Backgrounds
nodes.rationale: Universal QWidget background on QLabel caused striped dark boxes on every card; fix scopes backgrounds to containers only.

nodes.label: Range Button Segmented Control
nodes.rationale: 7/30/90-day buttons lacked selected state and competed with primary Import action; styled as quiet outlined controls with filled accent when checked.

nodes.label: String-Typed Temporal Read Contract
nodes.rationale: PyMySQL conv override returns DATETIME/DATE as plain strings matching original SQLite TEXT contract so models, services, and UI need no type changes.
